verdict_line: Efficiency Reimagined has banked $1.2B of a $3B full-year target, the Amazon glide-down is complete, and the CEO has named RFID and AI as the next lever. A funded programme with a public number attached to it.

thesis.text: The structural reset is complete. The Amazon glide-down eliminated roughly 2 million pieces per day of lower-quality volume and removed about $4.5 billion of related expense, 45 buildings closed in H1 and around 80% of Driver Choice participants departed in Q2.

Efficiency Reimagined is funded, named and measured — approximately $1.2 billion of programme benefits in H1 2026 against a full-year target of roughly $3 billion. The remaining $1.8 billion is someone's scorecard right now.

Guidance was raised. FY2026 revenue approximately $91.2 billion, operating profit approximately $8.65 billion, adjusted EPS approximately $7.22, with H2 domestic operating margin projected around 8.8%.
The CEO named the technology. Investment in RFID and artificial intelligence for package visibility, described as the most significant advancement in a decade.

exhibits.title: Q2 2026 and the cost of transformation
exhibits.headline: Revenue $22.8B with GAAP operating profit of $930M against $2.1B adjusted — the gap is the reset being paid for.
exhibits.body_html: Consolidated revenue $22.8 billion (+7.6%), GAAP operating profit $930 million, adjusted operating profit $2.1 billion (+12%), GAAP diluted EPS $0.71, adjusted diluted EPS $1.76. The GAAP figures carry after-tax transformation charges of $891 million ($1.05 per share), primarily employee separation costs from the completed Driver Choice Program.
exhibits.sowhat: An organisation absorbing this much restructuring has already accepted disruption. The hard decision is made. What follows a physical network reconfiguration is always a systems and decisioning reconfiguration — and that phase is beginning now.

exhibits.title: Revenue quality shift
exhibits.headline: Revenue per piece is rising faster than revenue in both segments — the company is now run on mix and pricing decisions.
exhibits.body_html: US Domestic revenue rose 6.0% on a 9.3% increase in revenue per piece, with operating margin of 0.1% GAAP and 8.0% adjusted. International revenue rose 12.5% on an 18.9% increase in revenue per piece, with margin of 12.4% on both bases. Asia-to-Asia export volume grew 13.6%. Management describes the business as more selective and focused on revenue quality rather than volume.
exhibits.sowhat: Yield outpacing revenue in both segments means the enterprise is being steered by pricing and mix decisions at enormous transaction volume. That is a data problem at a scale few companies have, and it is now the stated strategy.

financials.basis: UPS quarterly earnings releases filed with the SEC. Q3 2024 figures are computed from the year-over-year changes stated in the Q3 2025 release.
